column2: a sprite sheet for a grid robot programming game, chunky cartoon art, bold dark outlines, seen from directly above (top-down). 4 columns and 1 row: a cute round cleaning robot with a paint brush arm and a glowing eye, facing UP; a square grey stone brick wall block; a square floor cell splashed with bright blue paint; a square light clean floor tile with a thin border. Each item fills its square cell. arranged in a strict even grid with wide empty gaps between items, every item fully inside its own cell and centered, nothing overlapping, fully transparent background (real PNG alpha), no text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines
